value.rationale: The first nontrivial two-burst length-two deletion channel with an ordered two-symbol output is length six (length five leaves only one symbol). Its exact nonbinary six-read reconstruction threshold and complete all-alphabet equality-pair polynomial give a natural finite classification and quantify the previously unreported worst-case versus typical ambiguity separation, with rare-pair fraction \(4q^{-5}+O(q^{-6})\). This resolves a genuine nonbinary scope omitted from the binary multi-burst theorem rather than relabeling or recomputing its bound.
